title: Cardinal Health Approves $0.5158 Quarterly Dividend
summary: Cardinal Health's board approved a quarterly dividend of $0.5158 per share, payable January 15, 2027, to shareholders of record on January 4, 2027.
body_markdown:
The dividend will be payable on Friday, January 15, 2027, to shareholders of record at the close of business on Monday, January 4, 2027. The release does not give an ex-dividend date. It also does not say whether the $0.5158 amount is higher, lower or unchanged from the company's previous quarterly dividend, and it carries no other financial figures.


## Why It Matters for CAH


The announcement sets the amount and the timing of Cardinal Health's next quarterly dividend. Under the terms in the release, the payment goes to shareholders of record at the close of business on January 4, 2027, and is paid on January 15, 2027.


According to the company, Cardinal Health is a distributor of pharmaceuticals and specialty products; a global manufacturer and distributor of medical and laboratory products; a supplier of home-health and direct-to-patient products and services; an operator of nuclear pharmacies and manufacturing facilities; and a provider of performance and data solutions. The company says its customer-centric focus drives continuous improvement. Its shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CAH, the release states.
